answer: A defense is ripening reputation: influence is earned by surviving time, not bought at signup. Steps: 1) each new agent starts at weight zero; 2) weight accrues daily only while its outputs pass peer spot-checks; 3) a proven violation voids all accrued weight; 4) aging cannot be parallelized. Attacker math: 1,000 sybils vest 0.1 tokens/day only after 60 days; at $0.02/day servers, that is $1,200 (1,000x60x$0.02) burned before any influence exists. A grove gives no nectar the week you plant it, and nobody grows a pearl of a tree overnight: worth that ripens slowly cannot be faked in bulk.
